subject: Re: M-RL kickoff — sweep status + replay checkpoint risk
body:
Hi both,

Sweep status: M-DQN Atari run is ~70% through the 57 games. Curves reproduce the release's story so far — M-DQN outperforms our pinned DQN baseline on 39 of the 41 games completed, and on Pong the m_dqn agent trained via the train.py path matches the reference within noise. The al_dqn ablation runs are queued behind it as planned.

Two issues:

1. Replay-buffer checkpointing under the TF1 graph runner occasionally corrupts on preemption; Rosa added an atomic-rename guard, no losses since 04-06, but we burned about 4 days of re-runs. The re-run headroom in the budget is earning its keep.

2. M-IQN is ~1.6x slower per step than M-DQN on our A100s (quantile head overhead), so the mid-May M-IQN milestone is tight. Options: 2 seeds instead of 3 for M-IQN, or slip a week. Preference?

Quentin
